2608.02422.title: Agentic Incident Response through Digital Twin-Enhanced Multiscale Planning
2608.02422.paper_summary: Incident response is currently managed by security operators using predefined playbooks, resulting in slow, labor-intensive security decision-making processes. Consequently, there is a growing need for automated incident response planning. Decision-theoretic approaches based on control, optimization, and reinforcement learning have been proposed to automate such planning tasks with well-grounded approaches, yet most of which, while guaranteeing strong performance, are limited to abstract models and cannot be directly applied to operational systems. A promising approach to mitigate this limitation is to use the security knowledge embedded in large language models (LLMs) to develop agentic response systems. However, current agentic approaches rely on repeated invocations of the LLM to generate a response plan, which is unreliable and limits the planning horizon due to hallucination. In this paper, we develop a principled LLM-based planning method by combining decision-theoretic planning with LLM-generated response commands. The proposed agentic incident response approach uses a rollout planner to compute a high-level response strategy that allocates security resources (the tactical scale), which is then translated into executable commands by a lightweight LLM agent (the operational scale). Within this architecture, we use a digital twin that supports tactical planning through simulation and operational execution through emulation. Across three attack scenarios, our agentic approach reduces recovery execution time by 15.1\% on average and increases the recovery rate by 33.6\% over frontier LLM baselines.
2608.02422.paper_summary_zh: 事件響應目前由安全操作員使用預定義的行動手冊進行管理，導致安全決策過程緩慢且勞動密集。因此，自動化事件響應規劃的需求日益增加。基於控制、優化和強化學習的決策理論方法已被提出，以自動化這些規劃任務，並且有良好的理論基礎，但大多數方法雖然保證了強大的性能，但僅限於抽象模型，無法直接應用於操作系統。一種有前景的解決此限制的方法是利用大型語言模型（LLMs）中嵌入的安全知識來開發代理響應系統。然而，當前的代理方法依賴於重複調用LLM來生成響應計劃，這是不可靠的，並且由於幻覺限制了規劃範圍。在本文中，我們通過將決策理論規劃與LLM生成的響應命令相結合，開發了一種原則性的基於LLM的規劃方法。所提出的代理事件響應方法使用回滾規劃器來計算高層次的響應策略，分配安全資源（戰術層面），然後由輕量級LLM代理轉換為可執行命令（操作層面）。在這一架構中，我們使用數字雙胞胎來通過模擬支持戰術規劃，並通過仿真支持操作執行。在三種攻擊場景中，我們的代理方法平均減少了15.1\%的恢復執行時間，並比前沿LLM基準提高了33.6\%的恢復率。
